method: Cut the baby potatoes into even 1–2cm pieces. Boil for 8–10 minutes until just tender, then drain and let the steam escape for a minute.
Chop the onion and tomatoes. Heat the measured olive oil in a wide non-stick frying pan; cook the onion and tomatoes over medium heat for 4–5 minutes.
Add the potatoes in a single layer. Cook for 6–8 minutes, turning a few times, until the edges are golden.
Beat the large eggs, pour them into the pan and stir gently for 2–3 minutes until fully set, with no liquid egg left.
Serve the large eggs, potatoes and vegetables immediately. For another portion, follow the chilled-storage and single-reheat instructions.
